excerpt: Macaly is an AI website and app builder; its Macaly Cloud launch lets Claude, ChatGPT or Grok build and publish sites on Macaly's hosting, database and domains. Free plan with 100 Cloud actions a month; Starter $10, Pro $25. Pricing and alternatives.
content:
Macaly is an AI platform for building websites and web apps from a prompt. Its agent can plan a site by asking questions, match the style of a screenshot or sketch, rebuild an existing website from its link, or turn a document such as a PDF or spreadsheet into pages. Sites come with a built-in database, sign-in with Google or email, cookie-free visitor analytics, an SEO audit after each publish, Stripe payments and hosting on a macaly.app address or your own domain.

The Product Hunt launch was for Macaly Cloud, which lets you keep building inside Claude, ChatGPT or Grok while Macaly supplies the hosting, managed database, domain and more than 70 skills such as email, payments and analytics. You connect your assistant in one click, describe what you want, and tell it to publish. Changes made this way count as Cloud actions: the free plan allows 100 a month and paid plans have no monthly cap, though some skills use Macaly credits. Macaly says data is stored in Frankfurt and Ireland, that it does not train AI models on your content, and that you can export your code and data.

Macaly is made by Langtail. Macaly Cloud launched on Product Hunt on 30 September 2026 and finished #15 for the day with 128 upvotes and 7 comments; it was the seventh Macaly launch on the site.

We have not tested Macaly ourselves. This page brings together Macaly's website, Macaly Cloud and pricing pages, its Product Hunt page and reviews, and says where each fact comes from.

profile.platform: Web; connects to Claude, ChatGPT and Grok
profile.summary_short: AI website and app builder; Macaly Cloud lets Claude or ChatGPT build and publish on its hosting

use_cases: Building and publishing a website from inside Claude or ChatGPT
Launching a small business site with bookings, a database and SEO on your own domain
Rebuilding an outdated website from its link
Turning a PDF, spreadsheet or Google Maps listing into a website
Delivering client sites from separate workspaces as an agency

fit: already pay for Claude or ChatGPT and want hosting and a database without another builder subscription
are a non-developer who wants a site with sign-in, forms and payments
not_fit: need to publish more than one app on the free or Starter plan
want a traditional drag-and-drop editor rather than an AI agent
need a stack other than React, Next.js and Postgres

pricing.intro: Macaly has a free plan and monthly paid plans for individuals and agencies. Prices are in US dollars from Macaly's pricing page; it also shows CZK and EUR.

plans.name: Free
plans.detail: 1M monthly credits, 1 published app on macaly.app, 1 GiB storage and database, 100 Cloud actions a month

plans.name: Starter
plans.detail: 1M monthly credits, 1 app on your own domain, 5 GiB storage and database, analytics, Stripe, no Cloud action cap

plans.name: Pro
plans.detail: Unlimited custom domains, 10 GiB storage and database, GitHub, Stripe and Macaly MCP access

plans.name: Agency
plans.detail: For agencies running client projects in separate workspaces

notes: Extra database use and backend API calls beyond the allowance are charged in credits.
Website traffic has a monthly allowance but Macaly says it does not meter or charge for going over yet.
Custom plans for teams and agencies: hi@macaly.com.

alternatives.intro: Product Hunt lists Framer, Dorik and WebWave among Macaly's alternatives. Review scores are Product Hunt users' own; check each tool's pricing page for current prices.

items.name: Framer
items.what: Website builder with an AI design agent
items.difference: A visual design-first builder; Macaly is driven by an AI agent and can be used from Claude or ChatGPT.

items.name: Dorik
items.difference: Focused on websites and blogs; Macaly also builds apps with a database and sign-in.

items.name: WebWave
items.difference: A website creator with a visual editor rather than an agent connected to your AI assistant.

alternatives.more: Product Hunt also lists Hudby.io and Unicorn Platform.

liked: Easy for non-developers to build and deploy
Used for teaching: high-school students built first websites quickly

quotes.text: I tried Lovable and Macaly to create some websites, but personally I like Macaly much more.
quotes.author: Pavel Synek

quotes.text: Macaly has some built in UX surprises that make the entire process simple and absolutely delightful.
quotes.author: David Bentley Hurley

pros: Use the AI subscription you already have through Macaly Cloud
Database, sign-in, analytics and hosting included
Free plan with one published app
Data hosted in Europe; code and data can be exported
cons: Free plan limits Cloud actions to 100 a month
Free and Starter plans publish only one app at a time
Some skills use credits on top of the plan
Few launch-day comments to judge Macaly Cloud by

x.none: We found no posts about Macaly Cloud on X to link yet.

faq.a: A Macaly service that lets Claude, ChatGPT or Grok build and publish sites and apps on Macaly's hosting, managed database and domains, with more than 70 skills.
Yes, there is a free plan with one published app on a macaly.app address and 100 Cloud actions a month. Starter is $10 a month and Pro $25 a month.

faq.q: What counts as a Cloud action?
faq.a: Changes your AI assistant makes through Macaly Cloud, such as creating or editing files, publishing or running a command. Reading is free.
Macaly says it uses European infrastructure in Frankfurt and Ireland and does not train AI models on your content.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to Macaly?
faq.a: Product Hunt lists Framer, WebWave, Dorik, Hudby.io and Unicorn Platform.
